draft.title: Newton's laws and car safety
card: In a crash, a car stops very fast. The people inside keep moving forward at the car's old velocity until a force stops them. This is inertia.
The force that stops a person depends on their mass and how quickly their velocity drops to zero. A longer stopping time means a smaller acceleration, so a smaller force (F = ma).
Seatbelts stretch a little, airbags squash slowly, and crumple zones in the car's body fold up. Each makes the person's stop take longer.
The change in velocity is the same, but it happens over more time. The force on the person is smaller, so they are less likely to be hurt.
draft.remember: Safety features spread the same stop over more time, so the force is smaller.

a.q: How does an airbag reduce the force on a driver in a crash?
opts: It makes the driver's stop take longer
It makes the driver's stop take less time
It increases the driver's mass in the crash
It stops the car from slowing down so fast
a.why: An airbag squashes slowly, so the driver's velocity drops to zero over a longer time. That gives a smaller acceleration and a smaller force. Making the car stop more slowly is tempting, but the airbag acts on the driver, not on the car.
a.clue: Think about the time the stop takes.

b.q: Two identical test dummies hit a wall at the same speed. Dummy P is stopped in 0.1 s. Dummy Q is stopped in 0.4 s by a crumple zone. Which statement is correct?
opts: Dummy Q has a smaller force, as its stop takes longer
Dummy Q has a smaller force, as its mass is smaller
Dummy P has a smaller force, as its stop is quicker
Both feel the same force, as their speeds are the same
b.why: Both dummies lose the same velocity, but Q loses it over more time. Q has a smaller acceleration, and with the same mass the force is smaller. Equal speeds do not mean equal forces, because the stopping time also matters.
b.clue: The mass and the starting speed are the same. What differs?

a.best: It makes the driver's stop take longer

b.best: Dummy Q has a smaller force, as its stop takes longer
